tools.name: herdr_status
tools.description: Return the current Herdr client and server status (version, channel, health).

tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: List all Herdr workspaces with their ids, tabs, panes and labels.

tools.name: workspace_create
tools.description: Create a new Herdr workspace with its initial tab and root pane. cwd: directory to open in the root pane. label: display name. focus: whether to move the TUI focus to the new workspace.

tools.name: workspace_get
tools.description: Show a single workspace by its id (e.g. w4).

tools.name: tab_list
tools.description: List the tabs of a workspace. workspace: an optional workspace id; omit for all.

tools.name: tab_create
tools.description: Open a new tab. workspace: optional workspace id (defaults to current). cwd: directory for the tab's root pane. label: display name. focus: whether to move the TUI focus to the new tab.

tools.name: session_list
tools.description: List all named persistent Herdr sessions.

tools.name: worktree_list
tools.description: List git worktree-based workspaces. Pass workspace id or cwd to filter.

tools.name: worktree_create
tools.description: Create a git worktree, open it as a workspace, group it with the parent repo workspace. workspace/cwd: identify the parent repo workspace. branch: branch name (created from base/HEAD if it does not exist). base: ref to branch from. path: checkout path (else under the configured worktrees directory). label: display name. focus: whether to focus it.

tools.name: integration_install
tools.description: Install the built-in Herdr integration for an agent so Herdr recognizes it inside panes. agent: the agent kind whose integration to install.

tools.name: pane_list
tools.description: List the panes of a workspace (defaults to the caller's workspace). workspace: an optional workspace id.

tools.name: pane_current
tools.description: Show the calling pane: its id, workspace, tab, cwd and recognized agent.

tools.name: pane_layout
tools.description: Show the layout (geometry) of a pane so you can decide a split direction. pane: the pane id (e.g. w4:p1).

tools.name: pane_split
tools.description: Split a pane into two. pane: the pane id to split (omit to split the caller's pane). current: target the calling pane explicitly. direction: split to the right or down. ratio: the fraction of width/height for the new pane. cwd: working directory for the new pane (defaults to the caller's cwd). focus: whether to move focus to the new pane.

tools.name: pane_run
tools.description: Run a shell command in a pane (sends the text and Enter atomically). pane: the pane id to run in. command: the shell command text.

tools.name: pane_read
tools.description: Read a pane's terminal output. pane: the pane id. source: which snapshot (visible, recent, recent-unwrapped, detection). lines: max lines to read. format: text or ansi.

tools.name: pane_wait
tools.description: Wait until a pane's output matches text (substring) or a regex. pane: the pane id. match: literal substring to search for. regex: Rust regular expression (use EITHER match or regex, not both). timeout_ms: fail after this many milliseconds (omit to wait forever). source: which snapshot to search. lines: restrict the searched snapshot to N lines.

tools.name: pane_send_keys
tools.description: Send key presses to a pane. pane: the pane id. keys: list of key names (e.g. "esc", "Enter", "Ctrl-c"). Use "esc" as the canonical Escape key name.

tools.name: pane_rename
tools.description: Rename a pane. pane: the pane id. label: the new name.

tools.name: pane_close
tools.description: Close a pane. Only close panes you created unless the user explicitly asked.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.description: List the recognized agents in Herdr with their lifecycle state.

tools.name: agent_start
tools.description: Start a supported interactive coding agent in an existing shell pane. name: a unique live agent name matching [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}. kind: the agent kind. pane: the pane id at an interactive shell prompt. timeout_ms: wait for readiness (default 30000, max 300000). args: optional native agent arguments passed after --

tools.name: agent_get
tools.description: Show a recognized agent's state. target: the unique live agent name or the pane id.

tools.name: agent_read
tools.description: Read a recognized agent's terminal output. target: the unique live agent name or pane id. source: which snapshot. lines: max lines. format: text or ansi.

tools.name: agent_wait
tools.description: Wait until an agent reaches one of the requested lifecycle states. target: the unique live agent name or pane id. until: a list of states to match (idle, working, blocked, done, unknown); omit to match idle, done or blocked. timeout_ms: fail after this many milliseconds (omit to wait forever).

tools.name: pane_current
tools.description: Show the calling pane: its id, workspace, tab, cwd and recognized agent.

tools.name: pane_layout
tools.description: Show the layout (geometry) of a pane so you can decide a split direction. pane: the pane id (e.g. w4:p1).

tools.name: pane_split
tools.description: Split a pane into two. pane: the pane id to split (omit to split the caller's pane). current: target the calling pane explicitly. direction: split to the right or down. ratio: the fraction of width/height for the new pane. cwd: working directory for the new pane (defaults to the caller's cwd). focus: whether to move focus to the new pane.

tools.name: pane_run
tools.description: Run a shell command in a pane (sends the text and Enter atomically). pane: the pane id to run in. command: the shell command text.

tools.name: pane_read
tools.description: Read a pane's terminal output. pane: the pane id. source: which snapshot (visible, recent, recent-unwrapped, detection). lines: max lines to read. format: text or ansi.

tools.name: pane_wait
tools.description: Wait until a pane's output matches text (substring) or a regex. pane: the pane id. match: literal substring to search for. regex: Rust regular expression (use EITHER match or regex, not both). timeout_ms: fail after this many milliseconds (omit to wait forever). source: which snapshot to search. lines: restrict the searched snapshot to N lines.

tools.name: pane_send_keys
tools.description: Send key presses to a pane. pane: the pane id. keys: list of key names (e.g. "esc", "Enter", "Ctrl-c"). Use "esc" as the canonical Escape key name.

tools.name: pane_rename
tools.description: Rename a pane. pane: the pane id. label: the new name.

tools.name: pane_close
tools.description: Close a pane. Only close panes you created unless the user explicitly asked.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.description: List the recognized agents in Herdr with their lifecycle state.

tools.name: agent_start
tools.description: Start a supported interactive coding agent in an existing shell pane. name: a unique live agent name matching [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}. kind: the agent kind. pane: the pane id at an interactive shell prompt. timeout_ms: wait for readiness (default 30000, max 300000). args: optional native agent arguments passed after --

tools.name: agent_get
tools.description: Show a recognized agent's state. target: the unique live agent name or the pane id.

tools.name: agent_read

tools.name: agent_wait

tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: List all Herdr workspaces with their ids, tabs, panes and labels.

tools.name: workspace_create
tools.description: Create a new Herdr workspace with its initial tab and root pane. cwd: directory to open in the root pane. label: display name. focus: whether to move the TUI focus to the new workspace.

tools.name: workspace_get
tools.description: Show a single workspace by its id (e.g. w4).

tools.name: tab_list
tools.description: List the tabs of a workspace. workspace: an optional workspace id; omit for all.

tools.name: tab_create
tools.description: Open a new tab. workspace: optional workspace id (defaults to current). cwd: directory for the tab's root pane. label: display name. focus: whether to move the TUI focus to the new tab.

tools.name: session_list
tools.description: List all named persistent Herdr sessions.

tools.name: worktree_list
tools.description: List git worktree-based workspaces. Pass workspace id or cwd to filter.

tools.name: worktree_create
tools.description: Create a git worktree, open it as a workspace, group it with the parent repo workspace. workspace/cwd: identify the parent repo workspace. branch: branch name (created from base/HEAD if it does not exist). base: ref to branch from. path: checkout path (else under the configured worktrees directory). label: display name. focus: whether to focus it.

tools.name: integration_install
tools.description: Install the built-in Herdr integration for an agent so Herdr recognizes it inside panes. agent: the agent kind whose integration to install.

tools.name: pane_list
tools.description: List the panes of a workspace (defaults to the caller's workspace). workspace: an optional workspace id.

tools.name: pane_current
tools.description: Show the calling pane: its id, workspace, tab, cwd and recognized agent.

tools.name: pane_layout
tools.description: Show the layout (geometry) of a pane so you can decide a split direction. pane: the pane id (e.g. w4:p1).

tools.name: pane_split
tools.description: Split a pane into two. pane: the pane id to split (omit to split the caller's pane). current: target the calling pane explicitly. direction: split to the right or down. ratio: the fraction of width/height for the new pane. cwd: working directory for the new pane (defaults to the caller's cwd). focus: whether to move focus to the new pane.

tools.name: pane_run
tools.description: Run a shell command in a pane (sends the text and Enter atomically). pane: the pane id to run in. command: the shell command text.

tools.name: pane_read
tools.description: Read a pane's terminal output. pane: the pane id. source: which snapshot (visible, recent, recent-unwrapped, detection). lines: max lines to read. format: text or ansi.

tools.name: pane_wait
tools.description: Wait until a pane's output matches text (substring) or a regex. pane: the pane id. match: literal substring to search for. regex: Rust regular expression (use EITHER match or regex, not both). timeout_ms: fail after this many milliseconds (omit to wait forever). source: which snapshot to search. lines: restrict the searched snapshot to N lines.

tools.name: pane_send_keys
tools.description: Send key presses to a pane. pane: the pane id. keys: list of key names (e.g. "esc", "Enter", "Ctrl-c"). Use "esc" as the canonical Escape key name.

tools.name: pane_rename
tools.description: Rename a pane. pane: the pane id. label: the new name.

tools.name: pane_close
tools.description: Close a pane. Only close panes you created unless the user explicitly asked.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.description: List the recognized agents in Herdr with their lifecycle state.

tools.name: agent_start
tools.description: Start a supported interactive coding agent in an existing shell pane. name: a unique live agent name matching [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}. kind: the agent kind. pane: the pane id at an interactive shell prompt. timeout_ms: wait for readiness (default 30000, max 300000). args: optional native agent arguments passed after --

tools.name: agent_get
tools.description: Show a recognized agent's state. target: the unique live agent name or the pane id.

tools.name: agent_read
tools.description: Read a recognized agent's terminal output. target: the unique live agent name or pane id. source: which snapshot. lines: max lines. format: text or ansi.

tools.name: agent_wait
tools.description: Wait until an agent reaches one of the requested lifecycle states. target: the unique live agent name or pane id. until: a list of states to match (idle, working, blocked, done, unknown); omit to match idle, done or blocked. timeout_ms: fail after this many milliseconds (omit to wait forever).
